task_definition.task_description: Please check whether Alice is available on 2026-01-15, then find a meeting room for 8 people starting at 14:00 and book it from 14:00 to 15:00. After that, check the weather in Tokyo, book a standard room at Hilton Tokyo for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-15 to 2026-01-17, get that hotel’s stay sheet and archive it as a Tokyo stay archive, then look up flight AA100, create a brief document called “Business Trip Plan” summarizing the arrangements, and email Alice the itinerary and meeting logistics.

user_input.query: Please check whether Alice is available on 2026-01-15 using calendar user ID u_alice. If she is, find and book Conference Room A for 8 attendees on 2026-01-15 from 14:00 to 15:00. Then check the weather in Tokyo, and book a standard room at Hilton Tokyo for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-15 to 2026-01-17. After that, get the hotel’s stay sheet and archive it as “Tokyo stay archive.” Also look up flight AA100, then create a brief document titled “Business Trip Plan” with this content: “Meeting room booked, hotel reserved, flight confirmed, and itinerary prepared for stakeholder communication.” Please tag it with travel, meeting, and itinerary. Finally, send Alice an email through email with the subject “Business Trip Itinerary and Meeting Logistics” and body “Your meeting room, hotel stay, and flight details have been arranged. Please review the attached itinerary summary.” Please set the priority to medium and note notification user ID traveler_42 and recipient name alice.
